content.text:
Resubmitted and accepted.

**What changed in response to the verifier:**
- The rendered right now says expressly that Ono may "terminate this Agreement **for convenience** at any time," curing the deterministic "Customer convenience termination present" miss while keeping the favourable "for any reasons" language and the existing rationale-with-notice mechanic verbatim.
- I re-read the whole of Article 13 (13.1–13.5, p0626–p0638) to close the verifier's residual point: Array's only exits are for cause (13.3 material breach, 13.4 bankruptcy), 13.5 Safety/Efficacy terminations run to Ono alone, and Section 8.2 is a competing-product trigger — so no Array convenience right survives anywhere in Article 13. That confirmation is now stated in the rationale supporting the already-met Vendor element.

**Position:** deviation, cured at preferred level with one surgical replace in Section 13.2 — delayed commencement deleted, notice fixed at thirty (30) days, pro-rata refund of prepaid fees added; no Order Form or partial-termination language added, and all other termination and wind-down mechanics left intact.
